scope: Four exact source-English corrections; uncertain nuance retained in notes.

rows.revised_en: That was the wicked deed Kökchö committed then.
rows.note: The printed line attributes an act described as капыры to Kökchö. Wicked deed conveys the accusation without inventing a new event; exact nuance of капыры remains provisional.

rows.previous_en: Over the bare waist with a cold,
rows.revised_en: Crossing one mountain pass after another,
rows.note: The line describes repeated crossing of passes; prior English introduced a bare waist and cold.

rows.revised_en: My cherished one, born of my son.
rows.note: The source speaks in the first person of someone born of the speaker’s son; prior English supplied Manas as the father and changed the family relation.

rows.revised_en: Loading them onto Abeke the slave,
rows.note: The source names Abeke the slave, not the horse Aktulpar. The referent of the object remains dependent on the preceding line.
